meta_description: FSSAI Notified Revised List of Laboratories For Testing Of Fortificants - Learn about the recent FSSAI advisory that notifies laboratories authorized to conduct rice testing for compliance with food safety and quality standards. Ensure your rice manufacturing process meets FSSAI regulations with approved testing facilities.
body_html: Ensuring Quality and Compliance: On 3rd June 2024 the FSSAI has revised its list of laboratories for the mandatory and regular testing of fortificants in fortified rice, fortified rice kernels (FRK), and vitamin premix for FRK. Regular testing is essential to uphold quality standards and compliance. Explore the critical reasons for testing in this detailed update
